{{Quote|In the end, she sacrificed herself to keep my secret, to prevent the Sith from knowing about that touch of the Force inside me. She wasted her life to save me. Me.|Atton Rand, reflecting on the last Jedi he killed as a Sith|<ref name="KotOR II game" />}}
A '''[[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]''' was a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. At some point near the end of the war, she was [[Prisoner/Legends|captured]] by the [[Sith trooper (Sith Empire)|Sith trooper]] [[Atton Rand]]. She was able to show him his potential, and warned him that if his fellow [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] found out about him, they would break him into [[Dark Jedi/Legends|their ranks]]. Shortly after she was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Rand, for showing him [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].

==Biography==
===Encountering Atton Rand===
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was captured by [[Atton Rand]] near the closing days of the [[Jedi Civil War]]. She confronted Rand and informed him of his [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] nature, warning him that the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] would undoubtedly come after him and break him into a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] if they found out. Rand believed her since he had already heard rumors of disappearances of those who were found to be Force-sensitive in the ranks, but his hatred of the Jedi wouldn't allow him to see reason, and in retaliation he nearly [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] her to [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="KotOR II game" />

Then just when he thought she would die, she awakened [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] inside him, and allowed him to see life, to see what he was doing to it all around him by harming others. In response, he killed her. Disillusioned and pained with self-loathing, he deserted the Sith and went into hiding until the end of the war.<ref name="KotOR II game" />

===Legacy===
During Rand's journey with the Jedi Exile [[Meetra Surik]] he later revealed to her his past and that at first, he thought he would love to kill her, but at the end he killed her because he loved her. Rand's carefully woven web of lies eventually came crashing down; while on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] Surik was approached by [[Unidentified Twi'lek refugee|two]] [[Unidentified Twi'lek refugee 2|shady]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] refugees who told her that they had seen Rand when he was first in hiding there, and that he wasn't a mere [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], but a murderer. She confronted Rand about this, and while angry at her persistent questions, she had earned enough of his trust at this point that he told her the whole truth about his past. She forgave him for what he had done and welcomed him to stay with her on her journey to stop the Sith, and at his request she awakened him to the Force once again, and trained him to become a [[Jedi Sentinel/Legends|Jedi Sentinel]]. In this he became more and more loyal to her, starting to care deeply for her safety and welfare.<ref name="KotOR II game" />

==Behind the scenes==
This Jedi was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' during a conversation with Atton Rand.
